methodSections.heading: Bacon, Sour Cream & Chive Scones
steps: Broil or pan fry the bacon over a medium heat until lightly crisp.
Chop the cheese into small cubes, finely chop the chives and set both to the side.
Preheat the oven to 190°C (375°F) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
When the bacon has cooled, slice into small pieces.
Whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, sugar, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Cut cold butter straight from the fridge into 1cm cubes and then rub it into the flour with your fingertips until it's in dime-sized pieces.
Add the chopped bacon, cheddar cheese and chives and mix until well incorporated.
In a small bowl, stir together the sour cream and whipping cream. Add this into the other ingredients and mix until a dough just forms.
Turn out the dough onto a lightly floured surface and portion as desired. Remember, the less the dough is handled the better!
Place the scones on the baking sheet, brush with egg wash and bake for around 20 minutes until golden brown and a skewer poked into the centre comes out clean.
